title: Indie brand Monte Club is shaking up the tired male grooming industry
summary: With male grooming moving at a glacial pace at times, indie hair care brand Monte Club wants to make a difference in the stagnant category. Find out how its Pure Beauty Award-winning product and stellar marketing are making a difference

extraction.key_fact: 인디 헤어케어 브랜드 Monte Club이 정체된 남성 그루밍 시장에 변화를 노린다.
